notes: SMB, pre-seed growth -- product is a lightweight call-summarization layer that integrates with Zoom/HubSpot.
Primary ask: low-friction hosted API for real-time call summaries + embedding of snippets for buyer intent search.
PII concerns: want automatic redaction for phone numbers, emails, and custom regex (credit card) before storing embeddings.
Retention: marketing wants 90-day transcripts, sales wants 12 months for coaching. They asked: can retention be per-route?
Quote from CTO on call: 'We want to avoid building storage & redaction ourselves — need clear deletion APIs and retention defaults.'
Cost sensitivity: token cost and embedding storage are top concerns; trying to keep monthly infra <$1k until product-market fit.
Latency needs: summaries acceptable in 1.5-2s for short calls (<= 10m), but they'd like streaming summary start for longer calls.
Model preference: open to small Llama-family variants (cost) but want Redwood-curated options; fallback to cheaper 7b when spikes happen.
Security: asked about audit logs for API calls, KMS for keys, and SOC2 status — willing to sign DPA for hosted plan.
Integration notes: will glue via webhook to HubSpot; needs advice on prefix caching to reduce repeated token spend for frequent customers.
